external_entities.name: customer
external_entities.description: A customer who browses and places orders through the mobile app.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

external_entities.name: Marketing
external_entities.description: The internal marketing function that maintains the product catalogue.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Marketing keep the catalogue in a spreadsheet.

processes.name: mobile app
processes.description: The mobile application customers use to browse and order socks.
processes.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

processes.name: web API
processes.description: The API used by the mobile app and containing customer data in the user database.
processes.source_excerpt: The web API keeps customers in the user database

processes.name: SIMS
processes.description: The stock and inventory system that receives orders and dispatches order information.
processes.source_excerpt: SIMS, our stock and inventory system

processes.name: fax gateway
processes.description: The gateway that receives dispatch notes and faxes customer confirmations.
processes.source_excerpt: it sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway, which faxes the customer

processes.name: spreadsheet macros
processes.description: Macros in the catalogue spreadsheet that send SQL statements to the web API to change prices and product copy.
processes.source_excerpt: The macros in it send SQL statements straight to the web API to change prices and product copy

data_stores.name: user database
data_stores.description: The database containing customer names, addresses, and payment card information.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the user database: name, address, and the card they paid with
data_stores.notes: The source states that nobody can tell whether the user database is encrypted.

data_stores.name: flat file
data_stores.description: A flat file containing delivery addresses and nothing else.
data_stores.source_excerpt: a flat file kept alongside it — only addresses go in that file, nothing else
data_stores.notes: The source states that nobody can tell whether the flat file is encrypted.

data_stores.name: catalogue spreadsheet
data_stores.description: The spreadsheet containing the product catalogue, including prices and product copy.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Marketing keep the catalogue in a spreadsheet.

data_flows.name: browse and order
data_flows.description: Customer browsing and ordering through the mobile app.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Customers browse and order through our mobile app

data_flows.name: API requests
data_flows.description: The mobile app communicates with the web API over HTTP.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app talks to the web API over HTTP — not HTTPS
data_flows.notes: Nobody here can tell me what the API does about authentication.

data_flows.name: hand off order
data_flows.description: The web API hands an order over to SIMS.
data_flows.source_excerpt: When an order is placed the API hands the order over to SIMS

data_flows.name: write address
data_flows.description: SIMS writes the delivery address into the flat file.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It writes the delivery address into a flat file

data_flows.name: send dispatch note
data_flows.description: SIMS sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: it sends a dispatch note to the fax gateway

data_flows.name: fax confirmation
data_flows.description: The fax gateway faxes the customer a confirmation containing the customer's name and address.
data_flows.source_excerpt: which faxes the customer a confirmation with their name and address on it
data_flows.notes: The gateway dials the number stored against the order and nobody checks it arrived at the right place.

data_flows.name: keep catalogue
data_flows.description: Marketing maintains the catalogue in the spreadsheet.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Marketing keep the catalogue in a spreadsheet.

data_flows.name: change prices
data_flows.description: Spreadsheet macros send SQL statements to the web API to change prices and product copy.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The macros in it send SQL statements straight to the web API to change prices and product copy

trust_boundaries.name: office
trust_boundaries.description: The office location where the marketing laptop containing the catalogue spreadsheet is located.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The spreadsheet lives on a marketing laptop in the office.

assumptions.assumption: The user database is confidential because it contains customer names, addresses, and payment card information.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the user database contains customer name, address, and the card they paid with.

assumptions.assumption: The flat file is confidential because it contains delivery addresses.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the flat file contains delivery addresses and nothing else.

assumptions.assumption: The catalogue spreadsheet holds business-critical data because it contains the product catalogue, including prices and product copy.
assumptions.basis: The source states that Marketing keeps the catalogue in the spreadsheet and that macros change prices and product copy.
